items.title: Ramadan Begins Today as Saudi Arabia Confirms Crescent Moon Sighting
items.title_zh: 齋戒月今日開始
items.desc: Saudi Arabia confirmed the sighting of the crescent moon, marking the official start of Ramadan 1447 on February 18, 2026. Muslims worldwide begin the month-long fasting period.
items.desc_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯確認觀測到新月，2026年齋戒月（Ramadan 1447）於2月18日正式開始，全球穆斯林開始為期一個月的齋戒。

items.title: Tarique Rahman Sworn In as Bangladesh Prime Minister
items.title_zh: 孟加拉新總理就職
items.desc: Tarique Rahman officially became the Prime Minister of Bangladesh, marking the beginning of a new political era for the country.
items.desc_zh: Tarique Rahman 正式成為孟加拉國總理，標誌著該國政治新時代的開始。

items.title: US-Iran Indirect Talks: Preliminary Diplomatic Activities in Geneva
items.title_zh: 美國與伊朗間接會談前外交活動
items.desc: Oman's Foreign Minister met with US envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Geneva to prepare for upcoming US-Iran indirect negotiations.
items.desc_zh: 阿曼外長與美國特使Steve Witkoff及川普女婿Jared Kushner在日內瓦會面，為即將舉行的美伊間接會談做準備。

items.title: India and France Establish 'Special Global Strategic Partnership'
items.title_zh: 印度與法國建立「特殊全球戰略夥伴關係」
items.desc: The two countries announced closer strategic cooperation to address global instability. PM Modi stated AI models will be deployed globally to serve billions of users.
items.desc_zh: 兩國宣布建立更緊密的戰略合作關係，共同應對全球動盪局勢。莫迪總理表示AI模型將在全球部署，服務數十億用戶。

items.title: Saks Global Files for Bankruptcy Protection
items.title_zh: Saks Global申請破產保護
items.desc: Luxury retail giant Saks Global filed for bankruptcy reorganization, planning to leverage its premium real estate portfolio as leverage in negotiations with lenders.
items.desc_zh: 奢侈零售巨頭Saks Global申請破產重組，計劃利用其優質房地產組合作為與貸款人談判的籌碼。

items.title: ByteDance Releases Doubao 2.0 AI Model to Compete with DeepSeek
items.title_zh: 字節跳動發布豆包2.0 AI模型應對DeepSeek競爭
items.desc: ByteDance has released Doubao 2.0 AI model, optimized for the 'agent era'. Following DeepSeek's rise, ByteDance is accelerating AI development with its internal 'Seed Edge' AGI research team.
items.desc_zh: 字節跳動發布 Doubao 2.0 AI模型，針對「代理時代」進行優化。面對DeepSeek的崛起，字節正加速AI發展，組建內部「Seed Edge」AGI研究團隊。

items.title: DeepSeek Testing New Long-Context Model with 1M Token Support
items.title_zh: DeepSeek測試新長文本模型 支持100萬上下文
items.desc: DeepSeek is testing a new long-text model structure supporting 1M context length on its web/app platform. The API service remains V3.2 with 128K context. Industry expects a major announcement during Spring Festival.
items.desc_zh: DeepSeek 網頁/APP正在測試新的長文本模型結構，支持100萬上下文。API服務仍為V3.2，僅支持12.8萬上下文。業界預計春節期間可能發布重大更新。

items.title: China's Gold Investors: 60% Are New Players, Shift to Investment Focus
items.title_zh: 中國黃金投資者調查：近六成新玩家 轉向投資取向
items.desc: A survey shows nearly 60% of Chinese mainland gold investors are new players, and 70% don't buy gold jewelry, reflecting a significant shift toward investment-oriented purchases rather than traditional jewelry.
items.desc_zh: 調查顯示，近60%的中國大陸黃金投資者是新玩家，70%不購買金飾，反映從傳統首飾向投資型購買的重大轉變。

items.title: AI Battle in China: DeepSeek Reshuffles the Deck for Tech Giants
items.title_zh: 中國AI大戰：DeepSeek掀起巨頭生態卡位戰
items.desc: DeepSeek's popularity has dropped Doubao and Kimi's combined daily active user share from over 80% to about 60%, with DeepSeek capturing nearly 15%. ByteDance is now heavily investing in AGI research while maintaining Doubao as default.
items.desc_zh: DeepSeek的流行使豆包和Kimi的日活用戶佔比從超80%降至約60%，DeepSeek佔據近15%。字節跳動現正大力投資AGI研究，同時保持豆包為默認選擇。

items.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Closed for Lunar New Year Holiday
items.title_zh: 港股農曆新年假期休市
items.desc: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange is closed from February 15 (Sunday) to February 23 (Monday) for the Lunar New Year holiday. Trading will resume on February 24 (Tuesday). Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect services are also suspended.
items.desc_zh: 香港聯交所2月15日（星期日）至2月23日（星期一）因農曆新年假期休市，2月24日（星期二）恢復交易。滬港通服務亦暫停。

items.title: Asian Markets Closed: China, Taiwan, South Korea, Singapore Holidays
items.title_zh: 亞洲多國市場休市：中國台灣韓國新加坡假期
items.desc: Major Asian markets including mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, South Korea, and Singapore are closed for the Lunar New Year holiday, affecting global trading volumes and liquidity.
items.desc_zh: 包括中國大陸、香港、台灣、韓國和新加坡在內的主要亞洲市場因農曆新年假期休市，影響全球交易量和流動性。

items.title: Gold and Silver Prices Decline on Reduced Asian Market Liquidity
items.title_zh: 金銀價格因亞洲市場流動性降低而下跌
items.desc: Gold and silver prices continue to decline due to reduced liquidity from Asian market closures during Lunar New Year. Easing geopolitical tensions also put pressure on precious metals.
items.desc_zh: 由於亞洲市場在農曆新年期間休市導致流動性降低，金銀價格持續下跌。地緣政治緊張局勢緩解也對貴金屬造成壓力。

sections.title: 📈 港股關注 - 萬國數據 GDS

items.title: GDS Holdings Expects Higher 2026 Bookings Driven by Strong AI Demand in China
items.title_zh: 萬國數據預計2026年預訂增長 受中國AI需求推動
items.desc: GDS Holdings expects higher bookings in 2026 driven by strong AI demand in China. The company plans its first REIT asset injection in Q2 2026 involving assets valued at 4-6 billion RMB.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據預計2026年預訂量將增長，受中國強勁AI需求推動。公司計劃2026年第二季度進行首次REIT資產注入，涉及資產價值約40-60億元人民幣。

items.title: UBS Maintains GDS as Industry Top Pick, Bullish on New Orders and DayOne Valuation
items.title_zh: 瑞銀維持萬國數據為行業首選 看好新訂單及DayOne估值
items.desc: UBS continues to list GDS Holdings as its industry top pick, optimistic about potential new orders and DayOne's Series C funding valuation. The company's data center assets remain in high demand.
items.desc_zh: 瑞銀續列萬國數據為行業首選，看好潛在新訂單及DayOne C輪融資估值。公司數據中心資產需求保持強勁。

items.title: GDS Q3 Performance Shows Steady Growth, Entering AI-Driven Growth Cycle
items.title_zh: 萬國數據Q3業績穩健增長 邁入AI驅動增長新週期
items.desc: GDS reported solid Q3 results with high-quality growth. The company's CFO disclosed REIT development plans, with the first post-IPO asset injection expected in Q2 2026, targeting enterprise value of 40-60 billion RMB.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據報告穩健第三季度業績，實現高質量增長。公司首席財務官披露REIT發展計劃，IPO後首次資產注入預計2026年第二季度，目標企業價值400-600億元人民幣。

items.title: GDS REIT Listing Marks New Phase in Data Center Asset Securitization
items.title_zh: 萬國數據REIT上市標誌數據中心資產證券化新階段
items.desc: The Southern GDS Data Center Public REIT listed on Shanghai Stock Exchange in August 2025 as one of China's first data center REITs, marking a new phase in industry asset securitization.
items.desc_zh: 南方萬國數據中心公募REIT於2025年8月在上海證券交易所上市，作為中國首批數據中心REITs之一，標誌著行業資產證券化新階段。

items.title: Google Pixel 10a Officially Launched Today
items.title_zh: Google Pixel 10a 今日發布
items.desc: Google officially released the Pixel 10a smartphone on February 18. US carriers had already leaked full specifications. The device offers multiple colors with upgraded camera systems.
items.desc_zh: Google 於2月18日正式發布 Pixel 10a 智慧手機，美國電信商已提前洩露完整規格。新機將提供多種顏色選擇並搭載升級相機系統。

items.title: Global DRAM Memory Shortage Crisis: Tech Leaders Issue Warnings
items.title_zh: 全球DRAM記憶體短缺危機：科技領袖發出警告
items.desc: Musk (Tesla) and Cook (Apple) warn that AI boom causes severe DRAM shortage, potentially devastating corporate profits and disrupting production. Micron describes this bottleneck as 'unprecedented.'
items.desc_zh: 馬斯克（特斯拉）和庫克（蘋果）警告，AI熱潮導致DRAM記憶體嚴重短缺，可能重創企業利潤、打亂生產計劃。美光科技形容此瓶頸「前所未見」。

items.title: Apple Accepts Kioxia Memory Price Increase Amid Global Shortage
items.title_zh: 蘋果接受鎧俠記憶體漲價 應對全球短缺
items.desc: Apple reportedly accepted Japanese memory giant Kioxia's price increase agreement with doubled prices and dynamic adjustment mechanism, directly impacting iPhone production costs and profit margins.
items.desc_zh: 據報蘋果已接受日本記憶體巨頭鎧俠（Kioxia）的漲價協議，價格翻倍且採動態調整機制，這將直接影響iPhone生產成本和利潤率。

items.title: AI Film Academy Trains Next Generation of Hollywood Creatives
items.title_zh: AI電影學院培養好萊塢新一代創作人
items.desc: AI film academies specializing in training next-generation Hollywood filmmakers are emerging, teaching how to use AI technology for film production, sparking copyright discussions.
items.desc_zh: 專門培訓下一代好萊塢電影製作人的AI電影學校正興起，教導如何使用AI技術進行電影創作，引發版權討論。

items.title: 2026 Global Market Outlook: Synchronized Rally Expected Across Assets
items.title_zh: 2026年全球市場展望：各類資產同步上漲預期
items.desc: Analysts predict global liquidity, fiscal spending, and China's credit impulse are recovering, signaling synchronized gains in stocks, cryptocurrency, and real estate in 2026-27.
items.desc_zh: 分析師預測全球流動性、財政支出和中國信貸脈衝正在回升，預示2026-27年股市、加密貨幣和房地產將同步上漲。
